posts.author: ShippingFond
posts.text: DOF Group ASA - Awarded long-term contract in Africa Close i dag kl. 14:21 ∙ Oslo Børs DOF Group −0,08% DOF Group ASA ("DOF") has been awarded a Very Large* integrated Field Support Vessel (FSV) contract with an international oil company in Africa. The project will utilise Skandi Seven for a firm period of three years. DOF will deliver integrated services, project management, engineering, procurement and logistics for deep-water construction and maintenance of existing subsea assets. The work scope will also include transportation and installation of flexible products and various subsea equipment. Mons S. Aase, CEO DOF Group ASA said, "We are pleased to secure this long-term award with a repeat client. The contract builds on our extensive experience in the region and demonstrates the value of our integrated subsea offering. The three-year commitment provides strong visibility for Skandi Seven and our integrated services team, and we look forward to delivering safe and efficient operations for our client." *DOF defines a Very Large contract as a contract with a value between USD 100 million and USD 200 million. Contact information: Eirik Vardøy, Investor Relations DOF Group ASA Phone: +47 94 83 64 64
